emergence.summary: ARSA encodes the lysosomal enzyme arylsulfatase A (cerebroside-3-sulfatase), which removes the 3-O-sulfate from 3-O-sulfogalactosylceramide (SULFATIDE) -- the rate-limiting first step of sulfatide catabolism. Loss-of-function halts that step -> progressive lysosomal SULFATIDE accumulation in the myelin-forming oligodendrocytes (CNS) and Schwann cells (PNS) -> demyelination of the central AND peripheral nervous system -> progressive motor, cognitive and behavioural regression, spasticity and seizures (late-infantile / juvenile / adult forms graded by residual activity). Lysosomal sulfatide-catabolism axis DOWN; the kit's FIRST leukodystrophy and FIRST sulfatide substrate.
emergence.emergent_axis: lysosomal sulfatide (3-O-sulfogalactosylceramide) catabolic throughput sustaining CNS/PNS myelin

grades.perturbation_direction: [F] forced by (role x mechanism); cited biology
grades.perturbation_magnitude: [O] OPEN -- how far the switch moves is runtime/Layer-2, not sequence-derivable

per_gene.note: arylsulfatase A hydrolyses the 3-O-sulfate of sulfatide (with the sphingolipid-activator protein saposin B as cofactor); LOF blocks sulfatide degradation -> lysosomal storage in myelinating cells -> demyelination. Severe null / 0-activity alleles (e.g. the c.459+1G>A splice null; p.Pro426Leu) give late-infantile MLD; alleles retaining residual activity (e.g. p.Arg370Trp, the 'I' allele) give juvenile/adult forms -- the classic catabolic-enzyme deficiency-with-substrate-accumulation shape, now on a sulfatide/myelin substrate. (A clinically identical MLD also arises from LOF of the saposin-B activator PSAP; that is the activator-deficiency contrast, not the enzyme itself.)
per_gene.src: Polten 1991 NEJM 324:18 (ARSA molecular basis / genotype-phenotype); Gieselmann 2010 (MLD review)

levers.push_direction: restore endogenous arylsulfatase A by haematopoietic reconstitution with ARSA-overexpressing autologous cells: ex-vivo lentiviral gene-corrected CD34+ HSCs engraft, and their progeny -- including donor-derived microglia that migrate across the blood-brain barrier -- secrete supraphysiological ARSA that cross-corrects oligodendrocytes / Schwann cells -> the deficient sulfatide-degradation step is RESTORED -> demyelination halted/slowed; net axis effect UP toward function (DIRECT, on the causal enzyme).
levers.agent_class: ex-vivo autologous ARSA-lentiviral haematopoietic stem-cell gene therapy (atidarsagene autotemcel; Lenmeldy / Libmeldy)
levers.mechanism_grade: [O] ARSA expression level / sulfatide-clearance fraction / extent of myelin preservation not derived from sequence. Approved (atidarsagene autotemcel; FDA 2024 / EMA 2020) but ONLY for PRE-symptomatic late-infantile, pre-symptomatic early-juvenile or early-symptomatic early-juvenile MLD -- the corrective window CLOSES once demyelination is established, so TIMING (not magnitude) is the decisive limit; degree of benefit [O].
levers.src: Fumagalli 2022 Lancet 399:372 (atidarsagene autotemcel phase 1/2); Lenmeldy FDA approval 2024-03-18; Libmeldy EMA 2020

levers.push_direction: supply functional arylsulfatase A directly into the CNS (intrathecal recombinant enzyme) to restore the deficient lysosomal sulfatide-degradation step -> reduced sulfatide storage; net axis effect UP. (Systemic IV ERT does not cross the blood-brain barrier, so the CNS-predominant disease requires intrathecal delivery.)
levers.agent_class: intrathecal enzyme replacement therapy (recombinant human arylsulfatase A)
levers.mechanism_grade: [O] CNS enzyme distribution / clinical benefit not derived from sequence; intrathecal ARSA remains investigational (the systemic recombinant enzyme does not cross the BBB) -- [O].
levers.src: Dali 2020 Ann Clin Transl Neurol 7:518 (intrathecal ARSA trial)

falsifiers.claim: ARSA loss-of-function moves the lysosomal sulfatide-catabolism axis DOWN (sulfatide accumulates in myelinating cells)
falsifiers.falsifier: an ARSA LOF allele that LOWERS tissue / urinary sulfatide (i.e. raises catabolic throughput) refutes the axis-DOWN direction
falsifiers.measurable_by: leukocyte/fibroblast arylsulfatase A activity and urinary sulfatide quantification, stratified by ARSA genotype (controlling for the common pseudodeficiency allele)

falsifiers.claim: restoring ARSA (replace) is the CORRECTIVE direction (raises the deficient catabolic throughput)
falsifiers.falsifier: if ARSA gene-therapy engraftment that raised leukocyte ARSA activity FAILED to reduce CSF / urinary sulfatide, or accelerated demyelination, the 'replace' lever sign would be wrong
falsifiers.measurable_by: CSF/urinary sulfatide and MRI demyelination load vs leukocyte ARSA activity after gene therapy, stratified by pre- vs post-symptomatic treatment timing

gate_falsifiers.gate: falsifier register (>=1 measurable falsifier per disease)
